chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who has landed properties, some of them near one another, and he goes out and moves among them: should he complete or shorten? He said: “He should complete.”

key_terms.يَطُوفُ: moves around or goes among them

ai.seo_question: Should a person who travels between his nearby properties complete or shorten his prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat during travel for a person moving among his nearby properties. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rules that in such a case he should perform the prayer in full rather than shortened.
